study: Prospective transfer of a frozen financial table reader
population: Original documents and first eligible tables fixed by the separately registered selection protocol. All eligible event-specific USD facts chosen under that rule are retained. Any further document or table found after opening predictions is out of sample for this study.
unit: One independently verified event-attributable financial assertion per issuer or segment, measure, gross/net/tax basis where stated, status, valuation or reporting period and selected table. Equal values for different economic facts are distinct. Exact repetitions of the same event, accounting measure, owner and valuation collapse. Ranges form one claim. Missing cells and unexplained dashes are not zero; an explicit numeric zero is valid. A mixed-event total does not allocate individual amounts unless the filing uniquely says so. Preserve positive costs and negative accounting entries as printed.
source_reference: Before predictions are opened, two source readings check the genuine table structure including table legend, row and column, linked notes, immediately relevant context, named controls and units. Record coordinates and URLs, source hashes, displayed and signed USD amounts, owner, metric, status, period and basis where explicit. Seal references and selection with SHA-256; preserve disagreements and their disposition.
amount: Count an automatic prediction only when it targets the correct event and document and the exact absolute endpoints, scale and underlying source assertion match. The same number under a different event, line, or year fails. If equally valued assertions occur in one row require the correct column or corroborating context to identify the intended fact. Use one-to-one assignment, preferring full, then signed, then amount-only, in order to prevent duplicated predictions inflating recall. Report whether the prediction actually used a selected table cell. Independently report narrative-only support from outside the selected table.
signed: In addition to an amount match, sign and both endpoints must agree at the filing's convention. Convert parentheses or minus to negative when accounting notation indicates polarity. A positive loss magnitude remains positive. An explicitly positive scalar can be represented in an unambiguous positive monetary amount; for a negative value require signed information. If the source is a negative range, compare signed endpoints in their proper order. Percentages and mixed currency values are not USD records.
full: A complete table record requires signed amount, financial meaning, exact affected owner or segment, recognition/estimate/recovery/limit status, reported period/valuation, and gross/net/tax basis where explicitly stated. Unstated qualifiers may remain absent. Reported value must link to the correct visible cell and a source trail containing row and applicable column headers, currency/scale and an event title or allocating note if needed. A correct number with omitted or wrong fields earns only lower-level credit. The filing date alone cannot establish recognition period. Source grouping/segment may not be guessed from the parent issuer's name.
precision: Count unsupported and duplicate automatic proposals separately. Precision for distinct matches = distinct matched facts among automatic selected-table proposals. Raw support precision, if supplied, can include duplicates but must say so. Review-only rows never count towards automated recall or precision. Zero denominators -> null/undefined, not perfect. Stratify results by issuer and report pooled amount/signed/full recall and macro amount recall over issuers with positive references. Report count of negative cells and signed performance on them separately.
scope: Run each frozen method on the full original filing with identical passages, primary document and event query. Use the numerical evidence anchor or source-cell coordinates to attribute each output to the selected table. A prose result outside the selected table, even one repeating the same number, is an extra in the filing audit; flag corroboration separately. Review every full-filing extra as supported, unsupported, duplicate or review-only against its own passage, with reasons; no claim about full-filing recall on this selected-table corpus. Record unit/sign errors, mistaken controls, and table misses; no retuning on the holdout.
